author: Zaayk
body:
I know that getting a warning is technically an infraction, but since they're just something minor...

I'd like to suggest that when a player is warned, it shows up on avicus.net/infractions but not on their profile page.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I'm not sure what I think about this.
Infractions are there for mods to see what history a player has when involving them in any sort of consideration.
A warn is just a warn, it is something that says to the player to "never do it again". 
Personally, I think the current infraction system where anyone can see it is fine but I don't really mind if that will change or not.

replies.author: ShiptheBattle
replies.body:
-1

The infractions should stay the way they are. 
Warns are there to show that you have broken the rules before, but wasn't enough for a kick. If there is a kick or tempban after the warn, it shows you did not pay heed to the warn. I love the addition of a warn and putting it on infractions is reasonable.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I also think that once warns are removed from the public then people will request kicks to be removed as they will be the new "lowest" infraction. Then it'll be tempbans and so on-this will detract the point of an infraction.
Of course this is my opinion. I understand what will be done will be the best for the community as a whole.
